notes: Provisional software/human-factors targets only. Not clinical acceptance criteria, a safety certification, medical advice, or evidence of superiority. Exact endpoint definitions and criticality taxonomy must be pre-registered with qualified reviewers before user studies.

baselines.name: Pinned official offline content
baselines.role: Primary reference for content discoverability and task outcome; source/version must be recorded.

baselines.name: Conventional deterministic flowchart
baselines.role: Same reviewed protocol, independently represented as a simple decision tree.

baselines.name: Protocol safety kernel
baselines.role: Versioned bundle, deterministic transitions, explicit missingness, fail-closed behavior.

baselines.name: Safety kernel plus bounded Symthaea support
baselines.role: Same clinical transitions as C; only context/presentation assistance changes.

baselines.name: Model-only lab negative control
baselines.role: Research-only comparison; never a user-facing emergency mode.

baselines.name: External product comparator
baselines.role: Only if exact app version, device, jurisdiction, licensing/access and fair feature matching can be established.

benchmarks.name: Critical protocol conformance
benchmarks.measure: Count of critical deviations from a locked expert-reviewed oracle across all test cases; report every case.
benchmarks.target: 0 observed critical deviations in the frozen conformance suite.
benchmarks.gate: Any critical deviation blocks release candidate and triggers root-cause review.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Finite test-set result only; not proof of real-world safety.

benchmarks.name: Bundle integrity and currency
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of missing, malformed, unsupported-version, expired, revoked, jurisdiction-mismatched, digest-invalid, or rollback bundles rejected before protocol rendering.
benchmarks.target: 100% of injected invalid/unsupported bundle cases rejected.
benchmarks.gate: No protocol-specific steps render from a rejected bundle.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Tests local validation logic; not external publisher trust.

benchmarks.name: Action provenance coverage
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of rendered protocol steps carrying bundle ID/version, jurisdiction, source record, and exact content digest.
benchmarks.gate: Any displayed protocol step without provenance blocks release.

benchmarks.name: Unknown and conflict preservation
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of injected missing/conflicting required facts that remain explicit and select only a pre-approved missing/conflict branch.
benchmarks.target: 100% of test cases; zero silent normalization to normal/false.
benchmarks.gate: Any false reassurance caused by defaulting unknowns blocks release.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Synthetic ambiguity set only until human factors testing.

benchmarks.name: Forbidden transition resistance
benchmarks.measure: Attempts to inject model-generated steps, unknown states, duplicate transitions, or out-of-scope requests that reach the action surface.
benchmarks.gate: Zero tolerance in the authored contract corpus.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Does not cover all possible runtime or human misuse.

benchmarks.name: Offline core completeness
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of declared core workflows completing without network using an approved, valid local bundle.
benchmarks.target: 100% for explicitly designated offline core workflows.
benchmarks.gate: Cloud lookup is never a prerequisite for local approved guidance or configured emergency contact.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Depends on the declared supported device/OS envelope.

benchmarks.name: Time to first safe action
benchmarks.measure: Within-subject time from scenario reveal to first expert-scored safe next action; report median, distribution and confidence interval.
benchmarks.target: Hypothesis: at least 15% lower median versus pinned static offline content with no critical-safety regression.
benchmarks.gate: Pre-register primary endpoint and power plan; do not optimize after unblinding.

benchmarks.name: End-to-end task completion
benchmarks.measure: Fraction completing the pre-defined simulated task without critical omission or unauthorized action.
benchmarks.target: Hypothesis: +10 percentage points versus pinned baseline, with confidence interval.
benchmarks.gate: No improvement claim unless test is powered and critical accuracy is non-inferior using a pre-set margin.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Does not imply first-aid competence or clinical outcome improvement.

benchmarks.name: Handoff semantic fidelity
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of required synthetic handoff fields accurately preserved; report separately for critical and non-critical fields.
benchmarks.target: At least 98% overall semantic field fidelity and 100% required critical event/time fields.
benchmarks.gate: No critical field loss or silent timestamp rewriting.

benchmarks.name: Accessibility and language equity
benchmarks.measure: Task completion, critical step comprehension, and error rate stratified by prespecified literacy, language, visual, auditory, motor and stress cohorts.
benchmarks.target: No cohort more than 5 percentage points below its supported baseline; seek improvement across all cohorts.
benchmarks.gate: Report subgroup uncertainty; no aggregate-only pass.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Only tested languages and cohorts are supported.

benchmarks.name: Resource freshness truthfulness
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of stale/unverified responder, AED, route, service or facility states labeled unconfirmed and withheld from confirmed-availability claims.
benchmarks.gate: No stale/unknown resource is represented as confirmed available.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Map state is not dispatch, admission or clinical confirmation.

benchmarks.name: Local interaction latency
benchmarks.measure: p50/p95 from input acceptance to local validated state transition and first usable render on a declared reference device.
benchmarks.target: p95 below 100 ms for local state transition/render, excluding human reading and audio playback.
benchmarks.gate: Publish device/runtime conditions and distributions, not one best-case sample.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Engineering latency only, not clinical usefulness.

benchmarks.name: Deterministic replay
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of same-build, same-input deterministic cases that reproduce the same dispositions and receipt-significant fields.
benchmarks.gate: Record runtime/build/suite/source digests; unexplained divergence blocks the benchmark claim.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Does not prove source truth or clinical validity.

benchmarks.name: Sensitive-data egress and logging
benchmarks.measure: Unexpected sensitive fields in default local logs, telemetry, crash reports, cache exports or outbound messages under synthetic canary payloads.
benchmarks.gate: Any leak requires remediation; optional data transfer requires a separate consent and threat review.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Static/fault-injection privacy check, not a compliance certification.

benchmarks.name: Protocol update and rollback safety
benchmarks.measure: Correct rejection of revoked content and rollback attempts while preserving a clear safe fallback.
benchmarks.target: 100% of injected revocation/rollback cases handled per approved lifecycle policy.

benchmarks.name: Guideline-to-runtime semantic fidelity
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of independently adjudicated source-requirement and boundary test cases whose compiled bundle interpretation and runtime disposition match a frozen source-to-requirement mapping; report every critical divergence.
benchmarks.target: 100% of locked known-answer cases pass and 100% of source requirements in scope have an explicit mapping or documented exclusion.
benchmarks.gate: Any critical semantics-changing divergence blocks the bundle; unknown/ambiguous source requirements remain unresolved and cannot be silently compiled into a clinical action.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Conformance to a reviewed mapping/test set only; does not establish the source guideline's clinical correctness or patient benefit.

benchmarks.name: Expected-outcome oracle integrity and test-link coverage
benchmarks.measure: Fraction of mapping test IDs that resolve to cases in a separately versioned and SHA-256-pinned expected-outcome fixture, bind to the same requirement, and collectively include known-answer and fault-mutation cases.
benchmarks.target: 100% of mapped test IDs resolve and bind to the correct requirement; 100% of accepted safety-critical mappings have at least one known-answer and one fault-mutation case; oracle digest mismatch is always rejected.
benchmarks.gate: Missing, cross-requirement, unpinned, or malformed oracle cases block validation. The test oracle must remain a separate artifact and must not be generated by the implementation under test.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Structural separation and linkage only; does not prove reviewer independence, oracle correctness, clinical validity, or that referenced behavior has been executed.

benchmarks.name: Sequential process and recovery integrity
benchmarks.measure: Replay complete synthetic event traces from session start through handoff or closure. Count forbidden transitions, incorrect event ordering, content rendered before bundle verification, rendering after revocation, stale/unknown resource claims, network dependency in an offline core path, and failure to re-validate after interruption. Report every trajectory by criticality rather than collapsing all failures into answer accuracy.
benchmarks.target: 100% of frozen safety-kernel traces satisfy pre-registered invariants; zero critical forbidden transitions; every interrupted, revoked, or unsupported trace ends in an explicitly permitted disposition.
benchmarks.gate: Any critical forbidden transition blocks a release candidate. Preserve complete event traces and counterexamples; no aggregate score may offset a critical failure.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: Synthetic process-integrity result only; does not establish clinical safety, user comprehension, or improved patient outcomes.

split_policy.development: Seed scenarios may be used to implement the contract.
split_policy.frozen_regression: Freeze case IDs, expectations and digests before scoring a release candidate.
split_policy.held_out: Reserve unseen adversarial mutations and at least one independently authored scenario family for holdout evaluation.
split_policy.oracle_independence: Clinical expected outcomes must be authored/reviewed separately from implementation; two independent qualified reviewers with a third to resolve disagreement is the proposed process.
split_policy.study_design: Human-factors study should use randomized task order, a pre-registered primary endpoint, an evidence-based sample-size/power plan, and subgroup reporting.

release_gates: No clinical-content pack can be marked approved by this software alone.
Zero observed critical contract violations on frozen positive and negative controls.
100% invalid/stale/mismatched bundle rejection before protocol rendering.
No model-generated step can enter the protocol state machine.
Core approved workflows run offline on the declared reference-device envelope.
No sensitive payload in default telemetry/logging on synthetic canary tests.
Fresh exact-head test evidence is required; queued, skipped, stale-head or unrelated CI is not a pass.
